attempts.question:
This image is a crop from the front camera of a self-driving car.
The crop is centred on one pedestrian. Answer only about that pedestrian.

Return JSON only, no markdown:
{"visible": true, "color": "...", "type": "..."}

visible: true if the pedestrian at the centre of the crop is clearly visible;
false if it is hidden behind something, cut off, or not there.
color: the main colour of the pedestrian (for a pedestrian or cyclist: the main
clothing colour), exactly one of: white, black, gray, silver, red, blue, green, yellow,
orange, brown, beige, unknown.
type: exactly one of: car, SUV, van, pickup truck, truck, bus, motorcycle, bicycle,
pedestrian, traffic cone, unknown.
Use "unknown" when you are not sure.
